user_request: Use the returned expansion results to compare the previously fixed RF, Ridge, MLP32 and MLP64 and the effect of additional shapes.
label_access: No new timing labels parsed before this plan. Public collection and quality totals were inspected.
quality: Exclude every remeasure_tasks task and require all 18 raw rounds of a shape to be eligible for the common six-condition cohort. Do not relax quality thresholds or relabel REVIEW.
validation: Keep old complete 716 legacy validation shapes and separately report the accepted common expansion_validation cohort; no old or new test labels.
training: Reuse complete legacy_train 3345; add deterministic nested 1000, 3000 and all eligible expansion_train shapes, provided the additional common cohort exceeds 3000.
order: Existing per-seed A then C order; new shapes sorted by sha256 of gemm-expansion-20261106-SEED:MxNxK.
settings: Unchanged compare_learners.fit, original 15 static features and empirical Roofline constants; no hyperparameter search, no validation-based epoch stopping.
primary: Compare each fixed learner/target/condition before and after augmentation on both validation cohorts. Primary recommendation is the full augmented endpoint; choose learner/target by pooled old+new validation mean MAPE across seeds, then mean p90.
historical_baseline: Reuse and checksum the 144 stored n=3345 original model envelopes; re-evaluate on the new validation cohort without refitting.
diagnostics: Record train errors, subgroup errors, fit wall, epochs and all warnings. Any capped MLP fits receive a separate all-flagged max_iter=10000 audit; retain primary outputs.
